div.div: server, repo-server and controller all cache in Valkey (manifests, app state, sessions); every key has a TTL, so Valkey may evict it and Argo CD recomputes it. In use on 20 November 2026: about 500 Mi for Argo CD, plus about 166 Mi for four sidecars.
